Chapter 907: Chapter 10 Lost (Please Subscribe)

“Let’s head to another Immortal Domain.”

The beast-robed figure made up his mind.

There was no choice, as he had become thoroughly infamous within this domain. His life essence was locked on, and any action would lead to recognition by other immortals.

Subsequently contacting the various Immortal Cities, an endless pursuit would then ensue.

However, the beast-robed figure had no regrets. By killing the scion of the Lord of North Cold Immortal City, the treasure he acquired advanced his strength by several levels.

Even if given another chance, the beast-robed figure would choose to kill without hesitation.

Cultivation is a struggle: struggle against other immortals, struggle against the heaven and earth!

In the eyes of the beast-robed figure, those immortals without power but in control of numerous cultivation resources were his prey, the nourishment on his path of cultivation.

“Let’s see, which Immortal Domain to choose.”

The beast-robed figure pondered; the choice of Immortal Domain was crucial, at least for his continued cultivation.

“Hmm? A top-tier Alchemy Master has emerged in the Xuantian Immortal Domain? Named Yun Zhenzi?” Interest sparked within the beast-robed figure.

Top-tier Alchemy Masters were all rolling in wealth. The beast-robed figure had once attempted to assassinate a top-tier Alchemy Master, but was thwarted by the high-level Jade Immortal the latter had hired.

Top-tier Alchemy Masters, while in possession of vast wealth, also greatly valued their lives, willing to pay a substantial price for their protection.

“This Yun Zhenzi, a newly emerged top-tier Alchemy Master, has yet to hire a top-level Jade Immortal?” The beast-robed figure grew more interested.

The last time Yun Zhenzi made a move, nearly ten million years had passed, and the combat power he exhibited back then was slightly above average among Jade Immortals.

To the beast-robed figure, this was a plump sheep, even more enticing than the scion of the Lord of North Cold Immortal City.

A top-tier Alchemy Master, even a newly minted one, possesses insight far surpassing an ordinary Jade Immortal.

“The treasure I obtained from the scion of the North Cold City Lord elevated my personal strength by several levels. There won’t be any mishaps in dealing with a mere newly advanced top-tier Alchemy Master.”

The beast-robed figure was confident in himself.

As for the intel that Yun Zhenzi was extremely low-profile and seldom left his cave mansion, this posed no problem for the beast-robed figure.

Having the audacity to assassinate a city lord’s scion within an Immortal City, and escaping under the envelopment of numerous Immortal City killing formations, he was certain he could silently traverse the killing formations of Cangwu Immortal City and enter Yun Zhenzi’s cave mansion.

“Xuantian Immortal Domain it is.”

The beast-robed figure stood, merged with the world, and vanished from sight.

Xuantian Immortal Domain was adjacent to the Beizhou Immortal Domain, the distance was not far, and with such an ideal target as Yun Zhenzi, accomplishing this deed would ensure the beast-robed figure needn’t worry about cultivation resources for a good while.

…

Within the cave mansion.

The cultivation area.

Lin Yuan still sat cross-legged.

At this moment.

The void in front of him faintly distorted, and a figure appeared.

It was the Taiyin Primordial Spirit.

“These are cultivation resources.”

Lin Yuan opened his eyes, took out a spatial ring, and floated it in front of the Taiyin Primordial Spirit.

In fact, the Lin Yuan frequently residing within this top-tier cave mansion was not the true body, but the Taiyang Divine Spirit.

The top-tier cave mansion in Cangwu Immortal City had an irregular fissure that connected to the Origin of the Immortal Realm, where the Ancestral Master resided. Naturally, Lin Yuan would not let his true self stay here for long.

In the event of any extreme situation, attracting the Ancestral Master’s attention and losing the true body would be far more serious than losing a Primordial Spirit.

Hence—

Even without any incidents for over five hundred years, Lin Yuan still maintained the mode of his true body hiding in a secret place, while the Taiyang Divine Spirit stayed in Cangwu Immortal City, amassing numerous cultivation resources to support the true body’s cultivation.

The Taiyin Primordial Spirit’s visit was to deliver the cultivation resources earned by the Taiyang Divine Spirit to the true body.

Whoosh.

The Taiyin Primordial Spirit took the cultivation resources and quickly disappeared within the cave mansion.

…

Before long.

The Taiyin Primordial Spirit arrived at a subterranean location countless billions of miles away from Cangwu Immortal City.

There had formed a vast underground palace where the true body of Lin Yuan sat cross-legged at its center.

Whoosh.

The Taiyin Primordial Spirit appeared and brought out the spatial ring.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan swallowed all the resources from the spatial ring and soon felt a slight stirring in his heart, looking in a certain direction.

That was the surface above the subterranean palace, where the void faintly fluctuated and strands of black energy spread, quickly followed by the descent of seven or eight demonic beings.

“In recent decades, the impact of the Demon Abyss’s invasion of the Immortal Realm has become increasingly severe,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The specific manifestation was the frequency of demonic beings appearing in the Immortal Realm increasing, even in the remote area that Lin Yuan had specifically chosen. If demonic beings were invading there, it was even less likely that other places were spared.

“Why does the Ancestral Master not intervene?”

Lin Yuan’s brows furrowed, slightly puzzled.

Although the Ancestral Master was exalted, with these demonic beings clearly already affecting the immortals of the realm, especially in the wars between immortals and demons, countless Golden Immortals had perished. Even Jade Immortals could not all avoid misfortune.

With the twelfth-layer strength of the Ancestral Master, it would not be too difficult to suppress the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss, let alone preventing these demonic beings from invading the Immortal Realm.

Yet, time and again, wars between immortals and demons occurred.

The Ancestral Master, residing high in the Origin Source, overseeing the immortals, showed no intention of taking action.

“Forget it.”

“I need not consider these now.”

Lin Yuan reined in his thoughts, regardless of why the Ancestral Master did not prevent it, it bore little relevance to him. His current goal was to grasp as much as possible the Seventh Realm of time and space, as well as the fabled Chaos Rule.

“However, this temporary Demon Essence Channel needs to be dealt with.”

Lin Yuan glanced at the surface, and after the arrival of the seven or eight demonic beings, the space gradually stabilized, and a dark portal about dozens of meters wide began to take shape.

If the Demon Essence Channel was left unchecked, it would continuously spawn demonic beings. Even if Lin Yuan’s secluded underground palace remained undiscovered,

Once the Demon Essence Channel expanded further, attracting attention from the Jade Immortals of various Immortal Cities, a large number of immortals would be dispatched to reseal the channel.

At that time, it might be possible to discover traces of the underground palace.

The demons have low intelligence, operating only on instinct. Although they are formed by the breath of the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss, they have almost no spiritual wisdom.

However, the Jade Immortals are different, with numerous methods at their disposal. Lin Yuan does not wish to cause any unnecessary trouble.

The next moment.

The Taiyin Divine Spirit vanished.

When it reappeared, it had already reached the surface, standing before the rapidly forming Demon Essence Channel.

“Owoooo!”

“Roarrr!!”

The seven or eight demons, entering the Immortal Realm for the first time, were exhilarated. To them, the Immortal Qi of the Immortal Realm and the blood, flesh, and souls of the immortals were incomparably delicious, especially the flesh of the Jade Immortals which was an ultimate nourishment.

Every demon that invades the Immortal Realm, as long as they can return to the Demon Abyss safely, their strength would increase by dozens or even hundreds of times.

However.

Before these seven or eight demons could get a clear view of their surroundings, their consciousness began to plummet into darkness rapidly, and their flesh and souls were reduced to the most primal Demonic Qi.

“Is this Demonic Qi the breath of the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss?”

Using the Primal Force, Lin Yuan Taiyin Divine Spirit reverted the demons’ flesh and souls back to their origin, turning them into these insignificant wisps of Demonic Qi.

“Ancestor of the Demon Abyss…”

Lin Yuan observed carefully for a while, allowing these wisps of Demonic Qi to dissipate.

Being of the twelfth and ultimate tier, it’s not necessarily a good idea to retain even a trace of the opponent’s Demonic Qi.

Especially recently, the consciousness of the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss is about to reawaken, and it’s possible that up to sixty percent of its consciousness will return. At this time, any trace of Demonic Qi might become a ‘beacon’ for the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss.

“Demon Abyss…”

Lin Yuan looked at the dark channel before him. At this moment, with a thought, the space-time around the channel began to collapse, and the Demon Essence Channel also began to rapidly disintegrate.

“Once I attain the Seventh Realm of space-time comprehension, it might be worth a visit to the Demon Abyss.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself that with the Seventh Realm of space-time comprehension, he could be confident in preserving his life even in the twelfth tier Path Splitting Realm, considering the peculiar nature of the Demon Abyss’s existence.

If possible, Lin Yuan would naturally dive in for a deep exploration.

Moments later.

The Demon Essence Channel in front of him completely collapsed.

As if it never existed.

Seeing this, Lin Yuan finally turned and left.

The disappearance of the Demon Essence Channel was actually quite normal. For the numerous demons within the Demon Abyss, it was a common occurrence. If one channel disappeared, they would just move on to the next.

…

Time passed.

In the blink of an eye, ten years went by.

In Cangwu Immortal City, within the Cave Mansion Area.

The figure in the beast robe, now taking the form of a slender Golden Immortal, appeared in front of the Flying Immortal Hall.

“That place should be Yun Zhenzi’s cave mansion,” the figure in the beast robe glanced at the Cave Mansion Area.

The thirty-three Immortal Domains are vast and boundless. Even though the Beizhou Immortal Domain borders the Xuantian Immortal Domain, it took the figure in the beast robe a full ten years to reach Cangwu Immortal City.

“Ten years have passed. Does Yun Zhenzi still have no intention of hiring top-level Jade Immortals to protect him?” A flicker of surprise crossed the face of the figure in the beast robe.

Over the ten years, he never ceased to monitor intelligence on Yun Zhenzi, but he had never heard of any top-level Jade Immortals being employed by him.

“Is it confidence in the Immortal City’s protective Formation, or has he secretly hired them without my knowledge?” The figure in the beast robe couldn’t be bothered to ponder any further.

Since he had come here, it meant that he was determined to succeed. Even if Yun Zhenzi had already hired top-level Jade Immortal protection, he would still make his move to assassinate him.

Compared to his last attempt, after obtaining that treasure from the heir of the Lord of North Cold City, the figure in the beast robe considered his strength to have greatly increased, confident that he could swiftly kill Yun Zhenzi even under the protection of a top-level Jade Immortal.

“The Immortal City’s Formation?”

The figure in the beast robe arrived at the entrance to the Cave Mansion Area and smiled faintly. His figure merged with the heaven and earth, silently infiltrating the area.

Passing by mansion after mansion, the figure in the beast robe finally arrived in front of a first-class mansion.

This mansion was the one Lin Yuan was staying in.

“This Yun Zhenzi must have a close relationship with the higher-ups of the Immortal City. I can feel the Formation pressure in this area is much higher,” said the figure in the beast robe with a slightly solemn expression, “But it doesn’t matter much.”

He could almost ignore the Immortal City’s Formation entirely because of his acute mastery over space-time.

No Formation can exist without space-time; by mastering space-time, most Formations in the world become meaningless.

“Space-time…”

The eyes of the figure in beast robe faintly glowed whitish, and then he merged into the first-class mansion.

“Yun Zhenzi should be in the cultivation area.”

After he infiltrated the mansion, the figure in the beast robe quickly surveyed the surroundings and then headed towards the cultivation area.

Soon.

The figure in the beast robe arrived at the entrance of the core area.

“Yun Zhenzi…”

Excitement flickered across the face of the figure in the beast robe. Having infiltrated this far without triggering any alarms made him almost certain of his success in assassinating Yun Zhenzi.

Whoosh.

The next moment.

The figure in the beast robe disappeared again, entering the cultivation area of the mansion.

Like a pebble dropping into the endless ocean.

The figure in the beast robe, who had finally entered the core area, suddenly found that the world around him had changed, a vast realm of endless layers of space-time, so immense that the figure could see no end to it.

“What is this?”

The figure in the beast robe was stunned and looked around repeatedly.

An inconceivable thought surged in his mind at that moment.

Had he lost his way?
